title: Confidence Without Cause: Predicting and Localizing Physics-Shortcut Sensitivity in Language Model Hidden States
abstract: arXiv:2611.19403v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A language model's confidence on a physics problem deserves trust only if it ignores details irrelevant to the answer. We introduce DECOY (Distractor-Embedded Certified cOunterfactuals for phYsics): 155 families of four prompts differing in one irrelevant detail. A symbolic solver certifies that each edit preserves the answer. Families are labelled by the largest drop in the model's log-probability of the certified answer, using a threshold fixed before probe training. Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct is sensitive on 50.0% of the 140 families yielding labels, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on 22.9%. Effects are largest when distractor values lie numerically close to the answer. A linear probe on Qwen's layer-18 hidden state, averaged over four renderings, predicts sensitivity before generation at AUROC 0.760 with whole families held out. translated_title: 无根据的自信：预测与定位语言模型隐藏状态中的物理捷径敏感性
translated_abstract: 语言模型在物理问题上的置信度只有在它忽略与答案无关的细节时才值得信赖。我们提出了DECOY（面向物理的干扰项嵌入认证反事实）：155个家族，每个家族包含四个仅在某一无关细节上不同的提示。符号求解器认证每次编辑都保持答案不变。家族依据模型对认证答案的对数概率的最大下降进行标记，阈值在探针训练之前固定。Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct在产生标签的140个家族中有50.0%表现出敏感性，而Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct为22.9%。当干扰值在数值上接近答案时，这种效应最大。在Qwen第18层隐藏状态上训练的线性探针（对四次渲染取平均），能够在生成之前预测敏感性，在整族留出的情况下AUROC达到0.760；单独调优的单次渲染探针达到0.747；冻结的第16层探针在15个家族上达到0.820的汇总AUROC。
tldr: 该论文提出DECOY基准，通过符号求解器认证的反事实提示家族量化语言模型对物理问题中无关细节的过度敏感，并证明隐藏状态上的线性探针可在生成答案之前预测这种敏感性。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces DECOY, a benchmark of solver-certified counterfactual prompt families that quantifies language models' over-sensitivity to irrelevant details in physics problems, and shows that linear probes on hidden states can predict this sensitivity before generation.
